entities.summary: Stacy (b. 1990-08-18, Kota Kinabalu) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kota Kinabalu and Malaysia. Known in the fields of malaysia, composers & musicians, asia.
